description: This file defines the EnumFunction class, which extends Twig's FunctionExpression to implement custom behavior for 'enum'-related functions within Twig templates. It compiles calls to the 'enum' function, validating input and generating code to access enum cases.

classes.name: EnumFunction
classes.description: A custom Twig function node that handles enum validation and code generation within templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the function call, validating the arguments for enum existence and correctness, then generating the code to access the enum case.
